{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First 10 values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head(10))

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nNumber of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check if any are non-numeric after removing commas
# Strip commas and try to convert to float
try:
    df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    print("\nConversion to float succeeded for all rows.")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"\nConversion failed: {e}")"}
